<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Override a disposition with a reason"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/dispositions/{dispositionId}/override"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a NEW Disposition that supersedes the given one, carrying the
original's receipt line, grade and quantity, the operator's `outcome`
and a mandatory `reason` (400 `override-reason-required` when blank).
The original decision is never mutated. A RESTOCK override raises its
own `ReturnLineStaged` (idempotent on its disposition id). Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a\nretried request safe. The service always runs on Postgres, so it is\nrequired on every deployment and answered with 400\n`idempotency-key-required` when absent; a replay with the same key and\nthe same body returns the original response, while the same key with a\ndifferent body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}},{"name":"dispositionId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The disposition id (`disp-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":6,"maxLength":64,"pattern":"^disp-[^\\s/]+$"},"example":"disp-0c1d2e3f-4a5b-4e6f-9a7b-8c9d0e1f2a3b"}]}
